mapper.select: SELECT bill_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS billCount, SUM(total_qty) AS totalQty, SUM(total_amount_tax) AS totalAmount, SUM(profit_amount) AS totalProfit FROM sal_delivery WHERE bill_status IN ('CHECKED','FINISHED') AND deleted = 0 AND bill_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY bill_date ORDER BY bill_date

SELECT customer_id AS customerId, customer_name AS customerName, COUNT(*) AS billCount, SUM(total_amount_tax) AS totalAmount FROM sal_delivery WHERE bill_status IN ('CHECKED','FINISHED') AND deleted = 0 AND bill_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.bill_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS billDate, h.bill_no AS billNo, h.customer_name AS customerName, h.salesman_name AS salesmanName, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.product_code AS productCode, d.product_name AS productName, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.spec, ''), p.model) AS spec, d.unit_name AS unitName, d.qty AS qty, d.price AS price, d.amount AS amount, d.tax_amount AS taxAmount, d.amount_tax AS amountTax, d.cost_amount AS costAmount, d.batch_no AS batchNo FROM sal_delivery h JOIN sal_delivery_detail d ON d.delivery_id = h.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_product p ON p.id = d.product_id
ORDER BY h.bill_date DESC, h.bill_no DESC, d.line_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lineCount, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS billCount, COUNT(DISTINCT h.customer_id) AS customerCount, IFNULL(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS totalQty, IFNULL(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS totalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(d.tax_amount), 0) AS totalTaxAmount, IFNULL(SUM(d.amount_tax), 0) AS totalAmountTax, IFNULL(SUM(d.cost_amount), 0) AS totalCost FROM sal_delivery h JOIN sal_delivery_detail d ON d.delivery_id = h.id AND d.deleted = 0

SELECT product_id AS productId, product_code AS productCode, product_name AS productName, spec, unit_name AS unitName, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(available_qty) AS availableQty, AVG(avg_cost) AS avgCost, SUM(total_cost) AS totalCost FROM inv_stock WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY product_id, product_code, product_name, spec, unit_name ORDER BY totalCost DESC

SELECT product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, batch_no AS batchNo, qty, last_in_date AS lastInDate, DATEDIFF(NOW(), last_in_date) AS days FROM inv_stock WHERE deleted = 0 AND qty > 0 ORDER BY last_in_date

SELECT customer_id AS partnerId, customer_name AS partnerName, SUM(amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(paid_amount) AS paidAmount, SUM(balance) AS balance FROM fin_arap WHERE deleted = 0 AND bill_type = #{billType} GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(bill_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(total_amount_tax) AS totalAmount, SUM(cost_amount) AS totalCost, SUM(profit_amount) AS totalProfit, CASE WHEN SUM(total_amount_tax) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(profit_amount)/SUM(total_amount_tax)*100 END AS profitRate FROM sal_delivery WHERE bill_status IN ('CHECKED','FINISHED') AND deleted = 0 AND bill_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(bill_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount_tax),0) FROM sal_delivery WHERE DATE(bill_date)=CURDATE() AND bill_status IN ('CHECKED','FINISHED') AND deleted=0) AS todaySales, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount_tax),0) FROM sal_delivery WHERE bill_status IN ('CHECKED','FINISHED') AND deleted=0) AS totalSales, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount_tax),0) FROM pur_receipt WHERE DATE(bill_date)=CURDATE() AND bill_status IN ('CHECKED','FINISHED') AND deleted=0) AS todayPurchase, (SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*),0) FROM inv_stock WHERE deleted = 0) AS stockSkuCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(balance),0) FROM fin_arap WHERE deleted = 0 AND bill_type = 'AR') AS arBalance, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(balance),0) FROM fin_arap WHERE deleted = 0 AND bill_type = 'AP') AS apBalance, (SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*),0) FROM ( SELECT p.id FROM base_product p LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM inv_stock WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.deleted=0 AND p.status=1 AND p.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.safety_stock > 0 AND COALESCE(s.qty,0) < p.safety_stock ) x) AS warningCount
